brief:
Dozens of Israeli fighter jets and refueling aircraft approached Iran's border on Monday, the Palestine Chronicle reported, citing US sources. The operation prompted questions about whether Israel sought to provoke an Iranian military response. Explosions were reported in southern Iran during the incident.

US officials questioned the strategic purpose of the sortie, with some suggesting it may have been designed to elicit retaliation from Tehran rather than strike Iranian military targets directly.

title: Israeli jets approached Iran's border as sortie details emerge
